title: Check if a string is palindrome or not
problemStatement: Check if a string reads the same forwards and backwards.
intuition: Compare characters from both ends. Recursive: equal ends and middle is palindrome. Iterative two pointers is O(1) aux; recursion is O(n) stack.

approaches.title: Two pointers (optimal practical)
Recursive
approaches.idea: Base l>=r; else s[l]==s[r] and rec(l+1,r-1).

edgeCases: Case sensitivity / non-alphanumerics if problem filters them
commonMistakes: s == s[::-1] without discussing O(n) extra copy
followUps: Can you do it with recursion only as practice?
interviewInsight: Ask about case and allowed characters before coding — constraint clarification skill.
patternRecognition: Symmetric comparison from ends → two pointers
